Does not cover the WebFetch domain check, official marketplace auto-install, or gateway model discovery.
Opts out of operational metrics (Datadog log intake), feature-flag fetching and surveys. Does not disable /feedback.

telemetry_controls.effect: Opts out of error reports (Datadog browser intake). Does not affect feature flags.

Skips automatic registration of the official plugin marketplace; read at first interactive launch.

auth.method: apiKeyHelper command in settings.json; value sent in both Authorization: Bearer and x-api-key
auth.notes: Output cached 5 minutes by default (CLAUDE_CODE_API_KEY_HELPER_TTL_MS). A 401 on an expired token re-runs the helper and retries. ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY take precedence over apiKeyHelper and must not be set. Custom headers via ANTHROPIC_CUSTOM_HEADERS (2.1.227+). A helper that prints anything besides the credential fails (2.1.227+).
auth.helper_script: Included in config_snippets as get-apim-token.ps1; prints only the Entra access token for the gateway API, fails fast on wrong audience, expired token or az error.

model_discovery_endpoint_behaviour: Off by default. CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_GATEWAY_MODEL_DISCOVERY=1 calls GET <base>/v1/models?limit=1000 (3 s timeout) and keeps only IDs containing 'claude' or 'anthropic'. A best-effort HEAD <base>/api/hello is sent at startup.

config_snippets.content:
# Prints ONLY the raw JWT to stdout; on any problem prints a one-line reason to stderr and exits 1.
# Failing fast matters: both Claude Code and Codex retry hard on a bad token.
$Scope       = 'api://<apim-app-id>/.default'
$ExpectedAud = @('api://<apim-app-id>', '<apim-app-client-id>')   # accept both token forms
$MinLifeSecs = 60

$lines = & az account get-access-token --scope $Scope --query accessToken -o tsv 2>$null
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("get-apim-token: az failed (exit $LASTEXITCODE). Run: az login"); exit 1 }

# Tolerate banners/warnings on stdout: keep only the line that looks like a JWT.
$jwt = $lines | ForEach-Object { "$_".Trim() } | Where-Object { $_ -match '^eyJ[\w-]+\.[\w-]+\.[\w-]+$' } | Select-Object -Last 1
if (-not $jwt) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine('get-apim-token: az output contained no JWT'); exit 1 }

# Sanity-check the claims so a wrong audience or nearly-expired token fails here, not as an endless 401 loop.
$p = $jwt.Split('.')[1].Replace('-', '+').Replace('_', '/')
while ($p.Length % 4) { $p += '=' }
$claims = [Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([Convert]::FromBase64String($p)) | ConvertFrom-Json
$now = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds()
if ($ExpectedAud -notcontains $claims.aud) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("get-apim-token: token aud is '$($claims.aud)', expected '$($ExpectedAud -join "' or '")'"); exit 1 }
if ($claims.exp - $now -lt $MinLifeSecs) { [Console]::Error.WriteLine("get-apim-token: token expires in $($claims.exp - $now)s"); exit 1 }

[Console]::Out.Write($jwt)

limits: With feature-flag fetching off these are unavailable: Remote Control, claude import, /skill-doctor, claude.ai skill and plugin sync, advisor tool, MCP tasks, artifact comments, default PowerShell tool on Windows with Git Bash, Claude-drafted feedback, idle compaction.
No /feedback and no automatic updates; update manually.
Model names, context windows and capabilities for custom deployment names are not discovered; unrecognised IDs assume a 200K context window.
Remote Control is disabled when the base URL host differs from api.anthropic.com.
WebSearch behaviour behind a custom base URL is not documented.
